mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprises (company_name, company_logo, contact_name, contact_phone, company_address, business_license, status, registration_id) VALUES (#{companyName}, #{companyLogo}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{companyAddress}, #{businessLicense}, #{status}, #{registrationId})

UPDATE enterprises SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
